payload.core_composition_summary: Sort each course by cost, then greedily select cheapest compatible item from next course via linear scan with early break.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts all courses, then for each second course scans sorted first courses to find cheapest compatible. Similarly for drinks-desserts, then combines via sorted combined list. Sorting enables efficient greedy selection.
